Afotuo mmiɛnsa ma din kyerɛw. Nea edi kan: kyerɛw wo din wɔ nnawɔtwe mmienu mu bere a wotu baa fie foforɔ mu akyi.
Nea ɛtɔ so mmienu: nkuro pii mu, wohia appointment – mpɛn pii wobɛtumi ahyehyɛ wɔ intanɛt so.
Na nea ɛtɔ so mmiɛnsa: wobɛhia din kyerɛw krataa no mpɛn pii bio, sɛ nhwɛsoɔ no ma bank akawnt.
Enti sie no yie!
